Game Overview

At its heart, Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons is a casual game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons?

Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons is a free casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons free to play?

Yes, Chill Fishing 2 New Horizons is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
